== Description ==
'''LAPSE-60''' is one of the many Lapse Entities you may encounter, being the Lapse variant of [[SHA-60]].

== Behavior ==
Once '''LAPSE-60''' Spawns, it will begin rushing to the main room around the same way SHA-60 does, but being slightly quieter. The only way to detect it is watching for the small amount of static on the player's screen, or listening for the quiet audio. When LAPSE-60 reaches the current room, he will break down the door and sit in the center, similarly to regular A-60. Shortly after, he slowly rushes to the next door and collides with it, not breaking it but despawning. He has a chance to spawn SHA-2.

== Strategies & Tips ==
* lookout for any unexpected static and hide quickly, but not immediately.
* Make sure to stay near a locker/in a safespot as LAPSE-60 can chain, so dont think its immediately safe.

== Trivia ==
* [[Overseer]] took inspiration from [[A-60i]] while making '''Lapse-60''', as seen in [[Overseer|A-60i's Overseer death message]].
